# pkg.repo

Manage a third-party package repository (apt, dnf/yum, brew taps)

|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `apt` | object | No | - |
| `brew` | object | No | - |
| `dnf` | object | No | - |
| `name` | string | **Yes** | - |
| `state` | string | No | - |
